title: Page 200
transc:
Lieutenant paradise Biggs chief vinton here I
am now sending up to Saco Powhatan
the plug prolong and mansion plaster pontons
and patent material which reached here yesterday
from Bermuda publish and have so advised
Knox walrus H. W. Ben ham palate
Geo. D. Sheldon


Ft. Monroe June 13th 1864
Maj Eckert Di
Knox says can only protect line from blubber to Saco
how patton at present but can protects rest very soon
zebra from indications it is very important that line be 
built to that vernon immed'y pekin I have therefore asked
Bickford to send Perkins and party direct to Burr Moody
publish to wick to OBrien pedlar also peach operators zodiac 
Bickford to remain and take charge of closing out that
line Mack and party to do the work. unity Shelby
Abercrombie wishes white horse office kept open till Nabob and
mackerel arrive there which will be within perfume days probably
whelp night unity I think it will all come out
right as circumstances will allow pedlar teams and a good
saddle left Hastings this morning for wicoff vernon a cabal
about plug spoon long is tarquin at blubber zebra Bickford
whites that Johns snake are removed and his last plank
orderlies have been unable to find them and come back 16
Geo D Sheldon
